name: Item vs Supplier Report
query:
SELECT 
pr.name as "Purchase Receipt:Link/Purchase Receipt::150",
pri.item_code as "Item Code:Link/Item::120",
pri.item_name as "Item Name::150",
pri.rate as "Rate::120",
pri.amount as "Amount::120",
pr.supplier as "Vendor:Link/Supplier::150",
pr.posting_date as "GRN Date::120",
po.name as "Purchase Order:Link/Purchase Order:::180",
po.transaction_date as "Purchase Order Date::160",
poi.qty as "Ordered Qty::120",
pri.qty as "Accepted Qty::120",
pr.remark as "Remarks::150"
from `tabPurchase Receipt` pr
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
ON pr.name=pri.parent
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Order` po
ON po.name=pri.purchase_order
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
ON poi.parent=po.name
WHERE pr.posting_date >=%(from_date)s AND pr.posting_date <=%(to_date)s

name: Safety Stock vs Purchase Receipt
query:
SELECT
po.name as "Purchase Order:Link/Purchase Order::170",
poi.item_code as "Item Code:Link/Item::150",
poi.item_name as "Item Name::150",
poi.qty as "Purchase Order Qty::150",
ir.warehouse_reorder_qty as "Reorder Qty::150",
(poi.qty - ir.warehouse_reorder_qty) as "Additional Qty::130",
ir.warehouse as "Requested Warehouse",
pri.qty as "Accepted Quantity::150"
from `tabPurchase Order` po
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Order Item` poi
ON poi.parent=po.name
LEFT JOIN `tabItem Reorder` ir
ON (ir.parent=poi.item_code AND ir.warehouse=poi.warehouse)
LEFT JOIN `tabPurchase Receipt Item` pri
ON pri.purchase_order=po.name
